scripts.setup: corepack pnpm install && uv sync --project services/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "corepack pnpm api:dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @lapsignal/web dev"
scripts.dev:demo: corepack pnpm seed && corepack pnpm dev
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api/lapsignal services/api/tests
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --project services/api pytest
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
